description: Read one lesson from a course on the family's account: the full lesson guide text, what the lesson asks the student to do, and its video and resource titles. Identify the lesson by its number (e.g. "2.6"), or by words from its title. Knowledge-check questions and answers are never included.

courseId.description: EduAvenues course id from list_my_courses (for example "tj-prep")

lesson.description: Lesson number like "2.6", or words from the lesson title

name: get_lesson
title: Read a lesson
